messages:
sofia: Quick thread with the multi-workload bucket sweep across A100 vs H100 (EU & US regions). I ran prefill+decode for mosaic7b and mistral7b, q8x4 and fp16, steady 50 qps and a 5qps microburst. Results attached (csv + screenshots): https://redwood-internal.s3/bench/3801234567/sweep.zip :mag_right:
liam: nice, did you keep kernel selection forced or let runtime adapt?
sofia: let runtime pick by default but also ran a forced-kernel pass (cuBLAS-like vs fused-attn) to compare. Kernel map in the csv.
maya: top-line numbers pls?
sofia: summary below (per model, per gpu, per region)

sofia: ----- mosaic7b q8x4 -----
- H100 eu-west: prefill p50 18ms, decode p50 7.5ms, tokens/sec 980, $/1M tokens = $6.8
- A100 us-east: prefill p50 28ms, decode p50 9.2ms, tokens/sec 640, $/1M tokens = $10.5
- H100 us-east: prefill p50 20ms, decode p50 8ms, tokens/sec 920, $/1M tokens = $7.2

sofia: ----- mistral7b fp16 -----
- H100 eu-west: prefill p50 24ms, decode p50 10ms, tokens/sec 720, $/1M tokens = $9.1
- A100 us-east: prefill p50 36ms, decode p50 13ms, tokens/sec 480, $/1M tokens = $13.6

liam: big delta on prefill between regions for A100. thermal or placement?
sofia: noticed scheduling placed some A100s on older host firmware in us-east; also NVLink topology differences. ops-bot flagged 2 hosts with thermal scaling during long runs.
ops-bot: host: gpu-az-us-east-42 experienced sustained 85C for ~12m during the 50qps run, freq capped to 1.2GHz, AWS instance id i-0abcd1234 (logged)
ryan: did quantization change kernel choice? i.e., did q8x4 trigger different fused kernels?
sofia: yes — q8x4 used int8-capable fused-attn on H100 and fell back to slower cuBLAS matmul path on some A100 SKUs. csv column kernel_choice has "fused-int8" vs "matmul+scaling".
liam: any quality drop with q8x4?
sofia: small uptick in perplexity on devset (+1.8%) for mosaic7b samples with numeric-heavy prompts, but human eval on 200 prompts showed N/A regression for most tasks. Full eval in results/eval_report.md in zip.
maya: what about microburst tail p99?
sofia: p99 decode during 5qps microburst (burst to 250 concurrent tokens/sec): H100 p99 decode = 45ms, A100 p99 decode = 120ms. Prefill p99 also shows 2.5x worse on A100 in us-east.
perf-bot: auto-annotate: perf_delta_h100_vs_a100 = {"tokens_per_sec": "+50-60%","prefill_p50_ms": "-35% on H100","cost_per_1M": "-30% on H100"}
liam: can we attribute the cost differences purely to perf or differing on-demand prices?
sofia: both — spot price multiplier similar across regions but H100 throughput advantage drives $/1M down. I normalized to our SKU hourly rates in the csv.
ryan: action items?
sofia: short list:
- ops: reprovision 3 A100 hosts in us-east with latest firmware and re-run quick sanity (maya + ops)
- eng-runtime: add kernel-telemetry flag to capture kernel fallback reasons (liam")
